ModMetaData.name: Hospitality: Storefront
ModMetaData.author: Adamas
ModMetaData.description:
Adds a storefront tab to the cash register. Assign a colonist with a high social skill to sell goods in the shop.
Works standalone — vanilla caravan visitors and friendly faction pawns will automatically browse and buy from open stores. If the Hospitality mod is also installed, Hospitality guests are fully supported as before.
